body:
I've been trying various herbs in search of what are beneficial for both health of mind and body when I ran across Kratom online.
I bought some and tried it over a one week period with incredible success. I'd mix about 1.5 grams of the powder with water in a glass and drink it. The best time is around 4pm so that the effects start to kick in around 6pm and the entire evening is relaxing.It takes 1 to 2 hours for the Kratom to reach the system.
The effects I would describe as my whole body feeling soft inside and out, mind relaxed and comfortable without a care yet at the same time very clear headed. One effect that was huge plus for me that I hadn't read anywhere is that food tastes GREAT when I'm on Kratom. Takes about 5 hours for that effect to surface, but it lasts for the next 8 hours.
